steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Industry 4.0: the Fourth Industrial Revolution — cyber-physical systems, IoT, cloud computing and automation transforming manufacturing. | Key Fact: 3D printing (additive manufacturing): builds objects layer by layer from CAD models — rapid prototyping, custom medical implants, reduced waste. | Key Fact: Robotics: automated systems replacing repetitive tasks — increases consistency, reduces labour costs, raises ethical concerns about job losses. | Key Fact: Internet of Things (IoT): everyday objects connected to the internet — smart homes, wearable tech, data-driven design decisions.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Explain how 3D printing has changed the prototype development process in product design. | Discuss the social and economic impacts of increasing automation in manufacturing. | Evaluate how the Internet of Things could influence the design of a domestic kettle.
